scenario_name: Developer zone-level claims (Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone)
onsite_generation: 1GW+ private-wire renewables claimed: 800MW wind, 400MW+ solar, 2,400MWh battery storage, delivered by HFD Renewables
notes: Zone-level marketing claims (PUE 1.15, sub-5 gCO2e/kWh). APRS analysis argues the claimed renewables would need c.100 km2 and would still deliver only about half the energy a 500MW load requires; UK Government press release says zone energy 'drawn from on-site renewables'. Recorded on DV4 as the AIGZ context record; applies equally to DV6.
